reuse.verification: The official chapter explicitly states OGL v3.0 and third-party exceptions. No third-party notice was identified for these two illustrations in the chapter or SVG. The separate National Archives terms page returned HTTP 403 in this inspection; it was not retried.

source_description_paraphrase: The official chapter describes this illustration as time-limited parking for all vehicles during the displayed weekday and daytime interval. The separate no-return text is also visible in the asset.

from: stipulated Wednesday 10:00 and continuous stay of 25 minutes
derived_explanations.interpretation: Wednesday 10:00 is inside the displayed period; 25 > 20. The 40-minute no-return interval is distinct and irrelevant to this continuous-stay scenario. No legal contravention is adjudicated.

page_convention: facts.page identifies the source PDF page, or 1 for a standalone illustration; bboxes always refer to the candidate PNG, not the uncropped source page.
